evidence.excerpt: We propose two new benchmarks: an extension of Berlin Sparql Benchmark (BSBM) with text embeddings and an extension of DBpedia with image embeddings.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: RDF stores and SPARQL engines fulfill this function, enabling a range of retrieval and inference tasks on structured knowledge.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Against the baselines, vocabulary-time parsing alone yields median speedups of up to 41.9x on BSBM and 20x on DBpedia for single-type ranking; adding an approximate nearest-neighbor index yields speedups of 355x on BSBM and 97.8x on DBpedia.
